author: TeIq
content:
## Audit: Ozone moderator-action surface vs Polaris current state

Sources read:
- `/tmp/ozone/components/mod-event/constants.ts` — every event verb
- `/tmp/ozone/components/reports/ReportActions.tsx` — per-report buttons
- `/tmp/ozone/components/mod-event/helpers/emitEvent.tsx::emitEventsInBulk` — bulk shape
- `/home/doll/Polaris/polaris-types/src/action.rs` — Polaris `ActionKind`
- `/home/doll/Polaris/polaris-frontend/src/components/{report_list,action_composer}.rs`
- `/home/doll/Polaris/design.md` §5.1-§5.9

### Ozone's full moderator event set (30 verbs)

| Verb                          | Polaris equivalent | Status |
|-------------------------------|--------------------|--------|
| ACKNOWLEDGE                   | NoAction (no-op)   | partial — needs per-report button |
| ESCALATE                      | Escalate           | exists |
| LABEL                         | Label              | exists |
| MUTE / UNMUTE                 | Mute               | exists (no Unmute as discrete verb) |
| MUTE_REPORTER / UNMUTE_REPORTER | —                | **MISSING** (anti-abuse for spammy reporters) |
| TAKEDOWN / REVERSE_TAKEDOWN   | Takedown / Reverse | exists |
| COMMENT                       | —                  | **MISSING** (moderator note with no state change) |
| RESOLVE_APPEAL                | appeals::decide    | exists |
| EMAIL                         | —                  | **MISSING** (send moderation email to subject) |
| TAG                           | —                  | **MISSING** (categorical tags for queue routing) |
| DIVERT                        | —                  | **MISSING** (route subject's posts to alt queue) |
| SET_PRIORITY                  | —                  | **MISSING** (priority score on reports) |
| APPEAL                        | appeals            | exists |
| DISABLE_DMS / ENABLE_DMS      | —                  | MISSING (DM-restriction toggle) |
| DISABLE_VIDEO_UPLOAD / ENABLE | —                  | MISSING |
| MAKE_VERIFIER / REVOKE        | —                  | MISSING (trusted-verifier role) |
| AGE_ASSURANCE family          | —                  | out of scope (jurisdiction-specific) |
| REVOKE_ACCOUNT_CREDENTIALS    | —                  | MISSING (force re-auth) |
| SCHEDULE_TAKEDOWN / CANCEL    | —                  | **MISSING** (deferred takedown) |
| ACCOUNT / RECORD / IDENTITY   | —                  | bsky-internal notifications (skip) |
| Warn                          | Warn               | Polaris-only (Ozone has no Warn) |

### Ozone bulk operation shape

`tools.ozone.moderation.emitEvent` is per-subject; bulk = client-side
`Promise.allSettled` across subjects with the same event payload, plus
`scheduleAction` for delayed bulk takedowns. Polaris has NO bulk
surface today — every action is one POST per subject.

### Polaris design.md §5.5 + §5.3 intent

- §5.3: "Apply label X to every account that posted this image hash" —
  pattern-actions (`api/pattern_actions.rs` exists).
- §5.5: every action has reasoning + policy ref + 24h reversal —
  enforced by current `SubmitAction` shape.
- COMMENT/TAG/EMAIL/DIVERT are NOT in the design doc.

### Immediate visible bug (separate from missing verbs)

- `report-list__item` uses `grid-template-columns: max-content 1fr max-content` with no `min-width: 0` on children — long unbreakable strings (DIDs, AT-URIs in the report body) blow out the column width and push the whole panel past the case-view's main column.
- The report card has zero quick-action affordances; the moderator has to scroll down to the ActionComposer and fill it manually.

### Decided scope for this turn

1. Fix the overflow + redesign report card as a compact stacked block with status badge.
2. Add per-report quick-action row: [Acknowledge] [Escalate] [Open in composer] — each prefilling the ActionComposer with a sensible default reasoning + policy ref.
3. File follow-up issues #N for COMMENT, TAG, EMAIL, DIVERT, SET_PRIORITY, MUTE_REPORTER, SCHEDULE_TAKEDOWN, and BULK_ACTIONS so the remaining Ozone-parity gaps are tracked.
